title: Debt interest vs public service pay
subtitle: Comparing the annual cost of servicing government debt with the biggest public-service pay bills
debtInterestDefinition: Public sector debt interest payments, built from ONS NMFX monthly outturns and summed to completed calendar years.
publicServicePayDefinition: General government compensation of employees from ONS ESA Table 11, using the six largest top-level COFOG functions reported in annual current-price values.
